format.description: the envelope format; a change that breaks a consumer increments it

detail.description: summary or full: how much of each result the envelope holds

from.description: the older point in time; empty for the snapshot before the newer one

limit.description: the most results kept; 0 for every result

at.description: read each device's newest snapshot at or before this time; empty for the latest

device.description: the devices to read; empty for every device

file.description: one configuration file to read in place of the store

fresh.description: fetch the devices before reading them

vsys.description: the vsys to read; empty for every vsys

to.description: the newer point in time; empty for the latest snapshot

input.description: the question as answered, with the flow as simulated

answer.description: one line that says what the result found, as the text output prints it

scope.description: the configuration scope the result came from

kind.description: the object's container name, such as address or zone, or the rulebase and rule, such as security rule

old.description: a removed entry in one line

new.description: an added entry in one line

path.description: the setting's path below the entry, such as negate-destination or destination-translation/translated-address; an attribute's last segment starts with @

old.description: the value before: empty when the setting was absent, (set) for an element present without a value; a member list's members are sorted

new.description: the value after: empty when the setting is absent, (set) for an element present without a value; a member list's members are sorted

secret.description: true for a key, password or other secret: its values read (secret) and are never shown

undescribed.description: true for a setting the schema does not describe: it changed, but its values are never shown, as it may hold a secret

fields.description: the settings of a changed entry that differ

changes.description: what was added, removed or changed; with a limit, the scope where the limit falls holds only its first changes

results.description: the answers; empty when no target could be read

answer.description: the count line of the text output

found.description: results over every target, the omitted ones included; for snapshot diff, single changes

with.description: targets with a result; for snapshot diff, devices with a change

without.description: targets read without a result; for snapshot diff, devices compared without a change

omitted.description: results the limit left out; for snapshot diff, single changes; 0 when every result is shown

summary.description: search, lookup and snapshot diff only: the count of results over the targets read

holes.description: devices or snapshots the answer could not read; each one makes the answer incomplete

vsys.description: the vsys; empty for the device as a whole

value.description: the value that was not resolved

unresolved.description: values the answer could not resolve; each one can hide matches

vsys.description: the vsys; empty for the device as a whole

notes.description: facts that qualify the answer without making it incomplete, such as a stale snapshot

description: the snapshot diff answer, detail full
